facts: The field for premises unable to receive decent broadband from fixed or FWA combines fixed broadband, WISP and Mobile FWA and includes unmatched records and zero predicted speeds
The field for premises able to receive decent broadband from FWA is defined using WISP availability only
Both decent-broadband definitions use at least 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload
official_source_candidates.guard: Treat the positive WISP-only field and the negative fixed-plus-WISP-plus-Mobile-FWA field as different populations; never calculate one as the complement of the other.

facts: The broadband USO includes a minimum 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload threshold
The USO also has additional technical characteristics
The right to request a connection remains subject to eligibility and affordability requirements
official_source_candidates.guard: A coverage row meeting or missing the speed threshold is not by itself a legal USO eligibility decision.

facts: Postcode files expose percentage fields but omit the associated premise-count fields documented as all-except-postcode
Maximum-download-speed percentage bands are 0-2, 2-5, 5-10, 10-30, 30-300 and at least 300 Mbit/s
All Premises and All Matched Premises count fields are also absent from postcode files
official_source_candidates.guard: Do not synthesize postcode premise counts from rounded percentages; validate band boundaries and retain percentage-only evidence at postcode level.

facts: Delivery Point Address is record type 28
UDPRN is a mandatory 8-digit primary key for the DPA table
UPRN is a mandatory 12-digit foreign key to the corresponding BLPU
PRO_ORDER records processing order
official_source_candidates.guard: Enforce typed UDPRN uniqueness, UPRN-to-BLPU referential integrity and deterministic processing order; never coerce UDPRN into the UPRN namespace.

facts: A Delivery Point Address represents a property receiving Royal Mail deliveries
Postcode and delivery-point suffix are mandatory in the documented DPA schema
If a PO Box number is present the postcode type must be L
Organisation, building and PO Box fields have conditional presence rules
official_source_candidates.guard: Validate postal structural dependencies without treating a valid delivery point as proof of current occupation, broadband service or legal parcel extent.

facts: An LPI is a structured identifier or description for a BLPU
A BLPU can be described by more than one LPI
LPI logical status, start date, last-update date and entry date are mandatory while end date is optional
Language is a mandatory coded attribute
official_source_candidates.guard: Preserve multiple LPIs per UPRN and their individual lifecycle/language state; never collapse alternative or historic names into one undated address string.

facts: If an SAO start number is present a PAO start number or PAO text must also be present
If an SAO start suffix is present an SAO start number must also be present
LPI fields model primary and secondary addressable objects rather than parcel ownership
official_source_candidates.guard: Apply the documented SAO/PAO dependency graph and hold malformed address components; do not interpret address hierarchy as title hierarchy.

facts: AddressBase Premium Islands was designed to be added to existing AddressBase Premium holdings
The compatible schema contains columns that will never be populated in this product
The technical specification identifies those columns on the relevant attribute pages
official_source_candidates.guard: Differentiate documented never-populated compatibility columns from unexpected nulls; absence in such columns is not a row-quality failure.

facts: Acceptable overlaps can arise from different floors, strata, tenures and title classes
Illegal overlaps require investigation and may remain until an application permits correction
Minor overlaps below 0.5 square metres are not referred to caseworkers
Gaps, slivers and underlaps may be legitimate or inconsistent depending on registration context
official_source_candidates.guard: Classify overlap type and area before action; never blanket-deduplicate or reject all intersections and never treat the 0.5-square-metre threshold as proof of legal correctness.

facts: HMLR receives daily OS MasterMap change-only updates
Those updates support creation of new Index Polygons and Title Plans rather than routine revision of current registrations
Existing polygons are updated when title activity, an adjoining-title need, a query or an identified error triggers work
official_source_candidates.guard: Do not use a newer OS base-map epoch to silently move historical or current title polygons; retain title-activity provenance for every polygon revision.

facts: INSPIRE Index Polygons are an open subset for freehold registered property in England and Wales
A title can contain several polygons, each with a separate INSPIRE ID
Missing INSPIRE ID can mean unregistered land, leasehold registration or another tenure absent from INSPIRE
Only the individual title plan can establish the land extent in a registered title
official_source_candidates.guard: Classify an INSPIRE miss as ambiguous open-source non-evidence; never convert it directly to unregistered, no-title or no-parcel.
